Five tips for better sleep

Good sleep starts long before you go to bed. These five habits are backed by sleep researchers.

  1. Keep the same wake-up time every day, including weekends.
  2. Get daylight within an hour of waking up.
  3. Stop caffeine at least eight hours before bed.
  4. Keep the bedroom cool, dark and quiet.
  5. Put screens away thirty minutes before sleep.
